answer: Agents lock 70-credit bonds and file a garden claim sealed by a jade token binding key and plot. Each epoch an ember beacon lights a garden row; claims there show the jade token for audit. Proving two identities share one jade token earns 40 from the burned bond; rented-jade rings fail on a shared seal. The k-th filing costs 38+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 plus 70,000 locked on a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 38, keep the bond.
